</table>
<p id="A4.SS4.SSS2.Px2.p1.3" class="ltx_p">where <math id="A4.SS4.SSS2.Px2.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\rho_{i}=\pi_{\theta}(y_{i}\mid x)/\pi_{\theta_{\text{old}}}(y_{i}\mid x)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>ρ</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>π</mi><mi>θ</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>y</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo fence="true" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">∣</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>/</mo><msub><mi>π</mi><msub><mi>θ</mi><mtext>old</mtext></msub></msub></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>y</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo fence="true" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">∣</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\rho_{i}=\pi_{\theta}(y_{i}\mid x)/\pi_{\theta_{\text{old}}}(y_{i}\mid x)</annotation></semantics></math>.
Group-normalized advantages, global batch size <math id="A4.SS4.SSS2.Px2.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="48" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>48</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">48</annotation></semantics></math>, actor learning rate <math id="A4.SS4.SSS2.Px2.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="1{\times}10^{-6}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo lspace="0.222em" rspace="0.222em">×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>6</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1{\times}10^{-6}</annotation></semantics></math> with <math id="A4.SS4.SSS2.Px2.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="3\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">3\%</annotation></semantics></math>
warmup, ZeRO-3 / <span id="A4.SS4.SSS2.Px2.p1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">bf16</span>, non-reentrant gradient checkpointing, SDPA
attention.</p>
</div>
</section>
</section>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS5" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">D.5 </span>Screen-kNN implementation</h3>

<div id="A4.SS5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Screen-kNN predicts gene hits by finding the most similar historical screens
in the training set and aggregating their outcomes. Let <math id="A4.SS5.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{S}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒮</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{S}</annotation></semantics></math> denote
the set of training screens. Following the notation of the main text, each
training screen <math id="A4.SS5.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="s\in\mathcal{S}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒮</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s\in\mathcal{S}</annotation></semantics></math> has a gene library <math id="A4.SS5.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="L_{s}\subseteq\mathcal{G}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>L</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>⊆</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒢</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">L_{s}\subseteq\mathcal{G}</annotation></semantics></math> and binary hit labels <math id="A4.SS5.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="y_{g}^{s}\in\{0,1\}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mi>y</mi><mi>g</mi><mi>s</mi></msubsup><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y_{g}^{s}\in\{0,1\}</annotation></semantics></math> for <math id="A4.SS5.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="g\in L_{s}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>g</mi><mo>∈</mo><msub><mi>L</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">g\in L_{s}</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div>
<section id="A4.SS5.SSS0.Px1" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Prior.</h5>

<div id="A4.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We compute a global prior for each gene as its empirical
hit rate across all training screens in which it appears:</p>
<table id="A4.E14" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A4.E14.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="p_{0}(g)=\frac{\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}}y_{g}^{s}\,\mathbb{I}[g\in L_{s}]}{\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}}\mathbb{I}[g\in L_{s}]}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mo>∑</mo><msub><mrow></mrow><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒮</mi></mrow></msub><mi>y</mi><msub><mrow></mrow><mi>g</mi></msub><msup><mrow></mrow><mi>s</mi></msup><mi>𝕀</mi><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mi>g</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>L</mi><msub><mrow></mrow><mi>s</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mrow><mo>∑</mo><msub><mrow></mrow><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒮</mi></mrow></msub><mi>𝕀</mi><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mi>g</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>L</mi><msub><mrow></mrow><mi>s</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mfrac></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">p_{0}(g)=\frac{\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}}y_{g}^{s}\,\mathbb{I}[g\in L_{s}]}{\sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}}\mathbb{I}[g\in L_{s}]}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(14)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS5.SSS0.Px2" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Screen similarity.</h5>

<div id="A4.SS5.SSS0.Px2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS5.SSS0.Px2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">At round <math id="A4.SS5.SSS0.Px2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>t</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t</annotation></semantics></math>, the policy conditions on the
history <math id="A4.SS5.SSS0.Px2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="h_{t-1}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>h</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">h_{t-1}</annotation></semantics></math>, whose gene set <math id="A4.SS5.SSS0.Px2.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="G_{t-1}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>G</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">G_{t-1}</annotation></semantics></math> carries the labels <math id="A4.SS5.SSS0.Px2.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\{y_{g}\}_{g\in G_{t-1}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><msub><mi>y</mi><mi>g</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>g</mi><mo>∈</mo><msub><mi>G</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\{y_{g}\}_{g\in G_{t-1}}</annotation></semantics></math> observed so far in the current screen. For each training screen <math id="A4.SS5.SSS0.Px2.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="s" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>s</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s</annotation></semantics></math>,
we compute the normalized Hamming distance over the genes shared with that
history:</p>
<table id="A4.E15" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A4.E15.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\delta(s)=\frac{1}{|G_{t-1}\cap L_{s}|}\sum_{g\in G_{t-1}\cap L_{s}}(y_{g}-y_{g}^{s})^{2}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>δ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>s</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mrow><msub><mi>G</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo>∩</mo><msub><mi>L</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow></mfrac><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><munder><mo movablelimits="false" rspace="0em">∑</mo><mrow><mi>g</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><msub><mi>G</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo>∩</mo><msub><mi>L</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow></mrow></munder><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>y</mi><mi>g</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msubsup><mi>y</mi><mi>g</mi><mi>s</mi></msubsup></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\delta(s)=\frac{1}{|G_{t-1}\cap L_{s}|}\sum_{g\in G_{t-1}\cap L_{s}}(y_{g}-y_{g}^{s})^{2}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(15)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A4.SS5.SSS0.Px2.p1.2" class="ltx_p">If <math id="A4.SS5.SSS0.Px2.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="G_{t-1}\cap L_{s}=\emptyset" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>G</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo>∩</mo><msub><mi>L</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">∅</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">G_{t-1}\cap L_{s}=\emptyset</annotation></semantics></math>, we set <math id="A4.SS5.SSS0.Px2.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\delta(s)=1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>δ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>s</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\delta(s)=1</annotation></semantics></math>. Distances are
converted to weights via an exponential kernel with temperature <math id="A4.SS5.SSS0.Px2.p1.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\tau" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>τ</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tau</annotation></semantics></math>:</p>
<table id="A4.E16" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A4.E16.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="w_{s}=\exp\!\left(-\frac{\delta(s)}{\tau}\right)." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>w</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mpadded style="width:1.370em;" width="1.370em"><mi>exp</mi></mpadded><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>δ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>s</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mi>τ</mi></mfrac></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">w_{s}=\exp\!\left(-\frac{\delta(s)}{\tau}\right).</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(16)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS5.SSS0.Px3" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Prediction.</h5>

<div id="A4.SS5.SSS0.Px3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS5.SSS0.Px3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The screen evidence for gene <math id="A4.SS5.SSS0.Px3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="g" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>g</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">g</annotation></semantics></math> is the weighted hit
rate across training screens whose library contains <math id="A4.SS5.SSS0.Px3.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="g" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>g</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">g</annotation></semantics></math>:</p>
<table id="A4.E17" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A4.E17.m1" class="ltx_math_unparsed" alttext="p_{\text{screen}}(g)=\frac{\sum_{s\,:\,g\in L_{s}}w_{s}\,y_{g}^{s}}{\sum_{s\,:\,g\in L_{s}}w_{s}}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>p</mi><mtext>screen</mtext></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mo>∑</mo><msub><mrow></mrow><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0.448em" rspace="0.448em">:</mo><mrow><mi>g</mi><mo>∈</mo><msub><mi>L</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow></mrow></msub><mi>w</mi><msub><mrow></mrow><mi>s</mi></msub><mi>y</mi><msub><mrow></mrow><mi>g</mi></msub><msup><mrow></mrow><mi>s</mi></msup></mrow><mrow><mo>∑</mo><msub><mrow></mrow><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0.448em" rspace="0.448em">:</mo><mrow><mi>g</mi><mo>∈</mo><msub><mi>L</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow></mrow></msub><mi>w</mi><msub><mrow></mrow><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow></mfrac><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">p_{\text{screen}}(g)=\frac{\sum_{s\,:\,g\in L_{s}}w_{s}\,y_{g}^{s}}{\sum_{s\,:\,g\in L_{s}}w_{s}}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(17)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A4.SS5.SSS0.Px3.p1.2" class="ltx_p">The acquisition score is a Bayesian-style mixture of the prior and the screen
evidence,</p>
<table id="A4.E18" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A4.E18.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="a_{\textsc{knn}}(g\mid h_{t-1})=(1-\lambda_{t})\,p_{0}(g)+\lambda_{t}\,p_{\text{screen}}(g)," display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>a</mi><mtext class="ltx_font_smallcaps">knn</mtext></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>g</mi><mo fence="true" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">∣</mo><msub><mi>h</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>λ</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><msub><mi>λ</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>p</mi><mtext>screen</mtext></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">a_{\textsc{knn}}(g\mid h_{t-1})=(1-\lambda_{t})\,p_{0}(g)+\lambda_{t}\,p_{\text{screen}}(g),</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(18)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A4.SS5.SSS0.Px3.p1.3" class="ltx_p">where <math id="A4.SS5.SSS0.Px3.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\lambda_{t}=|G_{t-1}|/(|G_{t-1}|+\kappa)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>λ</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><msub><mi>G</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mo>/</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><msub><mi>G</mi><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><mi>κ</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\lambda_{t}=|G_{t-1}|/(|G_{t-1}|+\kappa)</annotation></semantics></math> interpolates between the
prior (when few genes have been revealed) and the screen evidence (as more
observations accumulate). We use <math id="A4.SS5.SSS0.Px3.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\tau=0.1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>τ</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0.1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tau=0.1</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A4.SS5.SSS0.Px3.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\kappa=100" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>κ</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>100</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\kappa=100</annotation></semantics></math>, and form the
batch <math id="A4.SS5.SSS0.Px3.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="B_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>B</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">B_{t}</annotation></semantics></math> from the <math id="A4.SS5.SSS0.Px3.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="b" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>b</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">b</annotation></semantics></math> untested genes with the highest score.</p>
</div>
<div class="ltx_pagination ltx_role_newpage"></div>
</section>
</section>
</section>

ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:70%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">,</span><span id="lstnumberx53.274" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:70%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx53.275" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:70%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">PCBP1</span><span id="lstnumberx53.276" class="ltx_text </span><span id="lstnumberx53.278" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:70%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">PCBP2</span><span id="lstnumberx53.279" class="ltx_text
